scripts.dev:admin: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run dev --workspace=apps/admin
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/server && npm run build --workspace=apps/web && npm run build --workspace=apps/admin
